newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Standard Bank dismisses executive.
newsitem.headline: Standard Bank dismisses executive.

text.p: South Africa's Standard Bank Ltd said on Monday it had dismissed one of its executives with immediate effect after discovering irregularities in his expense claims.

"Standard Bank announces it has terminated its relationship with Michael Borkan," the firm said in a brief statement. "Investigations reveal that Borkan breached the bank's regulations concerning travel and expense claims."
No clients' interests had been compromised, the firm added.
Borkan, a U.S. citizen, was head of sales and marketing in the financial asset services division of Standard Corporate and Merchant Bank.
"It is a function of integrity," a Standard Bank source said. "Standard Bank's culture does not put up with that."
